title: Mojo 1.0
summary: Mojo 1.0 is a new programming language developed by Modular (founded by Chris Lattner, creator of LLVM/Clang/Swift) that unifies Python's usability with systems-level performance, marking its first stable major release.
problem_solved: Addresses Python's performance limitations while maintaining its syntax and ease of use, bridging the gap between high-level scripting and low-level systems programming.
why_valuable: Enables developers to write Python-like code with near-C performance, potentially transforming AI/ML development and systems programming without sacrificing developer productivity.
